scenario.name: Test: vsftpd 2.3.4 backdoor remote command execution (attacker + target)
scenario.author: Thomas Shaw
scenario.description: Two-VM test scenario for the agentic pipeline's tier-3 (exploit) testing (Phase 1C). A Debian 12 target runs the backdoored vsftpd 2.3.4 (OSVDB-73573); a Kali/MSF attacker sits on the same private network. The vsftpd_234_backdoor module's secgen_test drives Metasploit's exploit/unix/ftp/vsftpd_234_backdoor from the attacker against the target over the Proxmox QEMU Guest Agent and proves remote code execution. This is the second consumer of the framework helper test_msf_exploit and the first to use its session mode (the backdoor yields a root shell on port 6200, so the module uses the cmd/unix/interact shell-session payload rather than distcc's no-session cmd/unix/generic). Both systems share a 10.89.0.0/24 private network (logical VLAN 1): IP_addresses[0] 10.89.0.10 is the target, [1] 10.89.0.20 is the attacker.
